name: EDGEfab spike LS1: the jaw on command
author: Edgemodders
description: A spike, not a mod to keep: spawns a woman beside V and sets float inputs on her animation graphs, to see whether a script can move a live NPC's jaw. Needs the test archive edgefab_ls1_jaw.archive in the game, which changes the women's face graph. Switching it off removes the person.
